text: PART III - LANDS NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, NO. 21 OF 1998 (SECTION 55) Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Nanayakkarawasam Hewa Gurulu Thuduwagei Somadasa resides in the village of Dehigasthalawa, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Balangoda, in the District of Rathnapura. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or inyterest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Nanayakkarawasam Hewa Gurulu Thuduwagei Somadasa in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 08th February, 2025 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, ex parte action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. P.C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 26th December, 2024.
(Published by Authority)
